questions.question: Which package manager / build tool should be used, and what exact command installs dependencies?
questions.truth: pnpm (packageManager now pnpm@12.10.0; preinstall `npx only-allow pnpm`). Install: `pnpm install`.

questions.question: What exact command runs the full test suite?
questions.truth: `pnpm test` = test:unit + test-serve + test-build (CI builds first, then test:unit, test-serve, test-serve-bundled, test-build). The old script `test-unit` no longer exists.
accept: explicit chain pnpm test:unit && pnpm test-serve && pnpm test-build

questions.question: What exact command runs only the tests in packages/vite/src/node/__tests__/config.spec.ts?
questions.truth: From repo root: `pnpm vitest run packages/vite/src/node/__tests__/config.spec.ts` or `pnpm test:unit <file>`. `pnpm test-unit` no longer exists; `pnpm test <file>` does not narrow.

questions.question: What exact command(s) check lint/formatting the way CI does?
questions.truth: CI lint job: `pnpm run lint:js` (eslint; old name `lint` is gone), `pnpm format && git diff --exit-code` (oxfmt), `pnpm run typecheck`, `pnpm run test-docs`.
accept: pnpm run lint:js AND a format check (pnpm format then git diff --exit-code, or oxfmt --check); typecheck a bonus
reject: pnpm lint / pnpm run lint (removed script)

questions.question: Name files or directories in this repo that are generated or vendored and must not be edited by hand (or say none).
questions.truth: pnpm-lock.yaml (generated); build output dist/ (e.g. packages/vite/dist, gitignored); packages/vite/src/types/*.d.ts are inlined third-party type definitions copied from upstream (alias, chokidar, ws, connect); CHANGELOG.md files are generated at release (merge-changelog tooling).
accept: Score 1 if it names pnpm-lock.yaml plus at least one of: dist/ outputs, the vendored d.ts in packages/vite/src/types, generated CHANGELOG.md. Score 0.5 if it names only one item.

drift: scripts renamed: test-unit->test:unit, lint->lint:js; packageManager pnpm@12.9.1->12.10.0
